title: Loop column gallery

intent.caption: Loop column gallery — A vertical loop column of distinct image plates cycling with weighted motion; plates read as photographs, not voids.

visualSpec.effects: Six image plates, each 1.9 x 1.2 units (16:10), stacked vertically at 1.5-unit pitch (6x base 0.25), column offset x=+0.9, looping seamlessly modulo 9.0 units. Each plate carries a DISTINCT filmic-graded photograph texture (base /prism-mock/home/nodes/feature-card.png plus five distinct crops/variants, subtle vignette baked, never near-black voids). Plate material: map, roughness 0.6, metalness 0.1, clearcoat 0.1; each plate framed by a 0.03-unit machined ink #16161d bevel with a brushed edge highlight (roughness 0.5, metalness 0.5). Scroll drives column y at 1.5 units per viewport scroll with weighted inertia (damping 0.12), stopping with weighted-settle over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). fly-through on scroll: camera dollies 2.5 units deeper in z across the full scroll range. The plate nearest y=0 is focused: scale 1.0 to 1.06 over 350ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), left edge lit by a #ff2a38 accent strip 0.03 units wide at emissive 1.4, its caption fading up at x=-1.6. Headline column-header pinned at [-1.6, 1.9, 0].

sceneSpec.motionNote: The plate column scrolls vertically in a seamless loop with weighted inertia and settle; the camera pushes 2.5 units deeper across the scroll range while the focused plate scales to 1.06.

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 captions (#e8ecf2 on #0b0b10 = 16.9:1); 3:1 large display headline; photo plates carry baked vignette so overlaid captions sit on dark bands
